title: A Plenty Of Advanced Enchants
description: This datapack adds new quality of life and combat enchants! It adds 19 new enchants (1 being secret), 1 curse, and modifies 13 vanilla enchants.
body:
This datapack adds new quality of life and combat enchants! It adds 19 new enchants (1 being secret), 1 curse, and modifies 13 vanilla enchants.

New Enchants:
- Bloodwrangling
- Burnless
- Compressive
- Concealment
- Firestrike
- Harping
- Ice Aspect
- Leaping
- Poisoning
- Reach
- Sculk Speed
- Shielding
- Slammer
- Splitarrow
- Swiftness
- Syphoning
- Toughness
- Withering

New Secret Enchant:
- ??? (Only accesible through creative)

New Curses:
- Curse of Asperity

Modified Enchants:
- Bane of Arthropods
- Blast Protection
- Density
- Efficiency
- Fire Protection
- Fortune
- Looting
- Projectile Protection
- Protection
- Sharpness
- Smite
- Thorns
- Unbreaking

![Top enchantments are the modified vanilla enchants, bottom are the custom enchants.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/885eb19e1e58ba6de827829d908fbbcca7fb3c2b.png)

I might end up posting the older versions of the datapack sometime in the future.
